text_block_list.text: "—Carry yourself as a queen should."
"—Dignity befitting an athlete."
"—Be graceful and ladylike."
"—I need to act more like myself."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*...!
*pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...?
What's the matter, Kawakami...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wow!? Really?
...Your eyebrows are twitching quite a bit, though.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
H-Hohoho... It is nothing at all.
Nothing at all, I assure you.

The day of the Kinko Sho.
While waiting for Kawakami Princess in front of the school gate:

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hello~! Are you
Kawakami's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu~n, ah~ha~...? Okay, I'm Pearl. Kawakami's roommate.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I have one message I'd like you to deliver.
Kawakami has a race today, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell her to live danceably and with passion!?
I'm cheering her on with all my heart!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
......

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Her heart was trembling like a leaf last night too.
I'm certain little Kawakami is feeling lost."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I love Kawakami, you know.
Both the powerful girl she was before,
and the earnest, hard-working girl she is now.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Just remember that much. Adieu~!
And in the waiting room at the Kinko Sho.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even though this race is a GII,
it's one I've declared as a goal for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So whether they are fans or not, everyone should be aware that I am racing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. There's something I want to tell everyone in the paddock."
choice_data_list: Is that what you really want to say?
Is that what you really want to say?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the Kinko Sho paddock should be starting soon.
Wanna go watch?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely watching! Man, this is the first time
I've seen Kawakami race since that live broadcast!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kawakami!
Come on, do your usual "I'll send 'em flying!" bit!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Strike a sparkling pose and say,
'I am the princess!'"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...? What're you doin'?
Bowin' all polite like that ain't like you...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, I...
Just as I said on that TV show before,
I will show everyone what a true Queen can be.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I shall act with consideration for my rivals, fairly and squarely,
without hurting anyone, behaving as a true competitor should."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, I shall strive to conduct myself
in a manner befitting an Umamusume and a Queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I shall live on without discarding who I am, nor my dignity.
I look forward to working with you...
